description: This Java class implements a rate limiter for managing message flow in an AMQP messaging system. It tracks message acknowledgments, redeliveries, and enforces constraints on unacknowledged messages and messages per period. Designed to be used within the actor's own thread, it helps regulate message processing to prevent overloads.

classes.name: MessageRateLimiter
classes.description: A thread-unsafe rate limiter for controlling message flow based on acknowledgment, redelivery, and timing constraints in an AMQP messaging system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MessageRateLimiter configured with parameters from Amqp10Config.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the rate limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getConsumedInPeriod
methods.description: Returns the number of messages consumed in the current period.

methods.name: getMaxPerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed messages per period.

methods.name: getInFlight
methods.description: Returns the count of messages currently in flight (unacknowledged or pending redelivery).

methods.name: getToBeRedelivered
methods.description: Returns the count of messages pending redelivery.

methods.name: getMaxInFlight
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed in-flight messages.

methods.name: getRedeliveryExpectationTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for redelivery expectations.

methods.name: incoming
methods.description: Records receipt of a new message, updating counters and redelivery set.

methods.name: terminallyAcknowledged
methods.description: Acknowledges a message with no redelivery expected, decrementing in-flight count.

methods.name: redeliveryRequested
methods.description: Marks a message as pending redelivery, updating counters.

methods.name: forgetPendingRedelivery
methods.description: Removes a message from the pending redelivery set.

methods.name: isConsumerOpen
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is currently open.

methods.name: isMaxPerPeriodExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the consumption exceeds the per-period maximum.

methods.name: isMaxInFlightExceeded
methods.description: Checks if in-flight and pending redelivery messages exceed the maximum allowed.

methods.name: reduceConsumedInPeriod
methods.description: Periodically reduces the count of consumed messages to allow for a sliding window.
